cards.front: Ha llamado Felicity; ¿puedes devolverle la llamada?
cards.back: Felicity called; can you call her back?

cards.front: Ha llamado Edna; está esperando a que le devuelvas la llamada.
cards.back: Edna called; she's expecting you to call her back.

cards.front: Ha llamado Dave: le dije que le devolverías la llamada.

cards.front: El presidente convocó una reunión con su gabinete.
cards.back: The president called a meeting with his cabinet.

cards.back: The president called a meeting with his cabinet to discuss the diplomatic crisis.

cards.front: El partido de la oposición convocó una reunión para hablar sobre la crisis diplomática también.
cards.back: The opposition party called a meeting to discuss the diplomatic crisis too.

cards.front: Van a convocar una huelga a menos que el diplomático extranjero dimita.
cards.back: They're going to call a strike unless the foreign diplomat steps down.

cards.back: The opposition party has called a strike for next Monday.

cards.back: The opposition party has called a general strike because of the diplomatic crisis.

cards.back: The president's called an election despite the fact that the foreign diplomat's already stepped down.

cards.front: Él ya ha convocado unas elecciones para el mes de marzo del año que viene.

cards.back: The opposition party leader says he and his cabinet have already called an election for next Tuesday.

cards.front: El presidente convocó una reunión de última hora con su gabinete.
cards.back: The president called a last-minute meeting with his cabinet.

cards.front: No se sabe por qué el presidente convocó una reunión de última hora.
cards.back: It's not known why the president called a last-minute meeting.

cards.back: Despite the fact that the president had to call a last-minute election, he feels confident about the future.

cards.front: Ya se ha convocado una reunión para hablar sobre la crisis diplomática.
cards.back: A meeting's already been called to discuss the diplomatic crisis.

cards.back: An emergency election's already been called because an important member of the party has stepped down.

cards.front: Ya se ha convocado una huelga para el próximo miércoles.
cards.back: A strike's already been called for next Wednesday.

cards.front: Vamos a tener que cancelar la reunión porque necesitamos darle prioridad a este proyecto.
cards.back: We're going to have to call off the meeting because we need to give priority to this project.

cards.front: Hemos cancelado la reunión para poder centrarnos en esta tarea.
cards.back: We've called the meeting off so we can concentrate on this assignment.

cards.front: La cancelaron para poder centrarse en un asunto más urgente.
cards.back: They called it off so they could focus on a more urgent matter.

cards.front: La conferencia se canceló ya que el jefe tuvo que darle prioridad a otra tarea.
cards.back: The conference was called off as the boss had to give priority to another task.

cards.front: La reunión de feedback se canceló ya que tuvimos que centrarnos en la preparación de la presentación.
cards.back: The feedback meeting was called off as we needed to concentrate on preparing the presentation.

cards.front: El inventario se canceló porque la dirección tuvo que centrarse en un asunto más importante.
cards.back: The stock-take was called off as the management had to focus on a more important matter.

cards.front: Yo que tú, llamaría a varios sitios antes de decidirme por una compañía de seguros.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd call around before you decide which insurance company to go for.

cards.front: Yo que tú, llamaría a varios sitios para asegurarme de que encuentras el mejor precio.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd call around to ensure you get the best deal.

cards.front: Yo que tú, llamaría a varios sitios antes de decidir dónde contratar el mejor seguro.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd call around before you decide where to purchase the right cover.

cards.front: ¿Este tren para en la estación de Oxford?
cards.back: Does this train call at Oxford Station?

cards.front: Yo que tú, pararía en la tienda de camino a casa para comprarle a tu mujer un regalo.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd call at the shop on your way home and buy your wife a present.

cards.front: Yo que tú, le haría una visita a Mark para ver cómo está.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd call at Mark's to check up on him.

cards.front: ¡Si yo fuera tú, contestaría a la profesora cuando dice tu nombre!
cards.back: If I were you, I'd answer the teacher when she calls out your name!

cards.front: Estaba ocupado en mi mesa centrándome en la tarea cuando el jefe gritó mi nombre.
cards.back: I was busy at my desk focusing on my task, when the boss called out my name.

cards.front: Si la gente deja de llamarnos, podemos seguir centrándonos en el proyecto.
cards.back: If people stop calling out to us, we can continue to concentrate on the project.

cards.front: No uso mi móvil para hacer ninguna llamada de larga distancia.
cards.back: I don't use my mobile to make any long-distance calls.

cards.front: Uso el teléfono de la oficina para hacer llamadas de larga distancia.
cards.back: I use the office phone to make long-distance calls.

cards.front: Me compré una de esas tarjetas para hacer llamadas de larga distancia por sólo quince pavos.
cards.back: I got one of those cards for making long-distance calls for only fifteen quid.

cards.front: Tengo cinco llamadas perdidas de Jezza.
cards.back: I've got five missed calls from Jezza.

cards.front: Hazme una llamada perdida cuando salgas de la oficina.
cards.back: Give me a missed call when you leave the office.

cards.front: Cuando miré el móvil, tenía diez llamadas perdidas de Julie.
cards.back: When I checked my mobile, I had ten missed calls from Julie.

cards.front: Esta línea es sólo para llamadas de emergencia, señor.
cards.back: This line is for emergency calls only, sir.

cards.front: Hicieron una llamada de emergencia desde el teléfono de la oficina.
cards.back: They made an emergency call from the office phone.

cards.front: Mi madre me dijo que no debía hacer nunca una llamada de emergencia a menos que estuviera metido en problemas graves.
cards.back: My mother told me I should never make an emergency call unless I was in serious trouble.

cards.front: Mi madre me dijo que no debería nunca hacer bromas por teléfono.
cards.back: My mother told me I should never make prank calls.

cards.front: Si hacemos bromas por teléfono a Jezza, vamos a meternos en un grave problema.
cards.back: If we make a prank call to Jezza, we're going to get into serious trouble.

cards.front: No voy a hacer bromas por teléfono a Jezza a menos que me des quince pavos.
cards.back: I'm not going to make a prank call to Jezza unless you give me fifteen quid.

cards.front: No puedo enrollarme mucho porque estoy con el móvil y se me está acabando el crédito.
cards.back: This can't be a long call because I'm on my mobile and I'm running out of credit.

cards.front: A menos que añada crédito, sólo puedo hacer una llamada rápida.
cards.back: Unless I add more credit, I can only make a short call.

cards.front: Ésta va a tener que ser una llamada rápida porque estoy con el teléfono de la oficina.
cards.back: This is going to have to be a short call because I'm on the office phone.

cards.front: Le di un telefonazo a él ayer, pero se me cortó la llamada.
cards.back: I gave him a call yesterday, but I got cut off.

cards.front: Le he dado un telefonazo a ella esta mañana, pero se me cortó la llamada.
cards.back: I gave her a call this morning, but I got cut off.

cards.front: Le di un telefonazo al jefe anteayer, pero se cortó la llamada.
cards.back: I gave the boss a call the day before yesterday, but we got cut off.

cards.front: Le llamé ayer, pero me saltó el contestador.
cards.back: I phoned him yesterday, but it went straight into voicemail.

cards.front: La he llamado dos veces esta mañana, pero me ha saltado el contestador.
cards.back: I've phoned her twice this morning, but it went straight into voicemail.

cards.front: Llamé al jefe anteayer, pero me saltó el contestador.
cards.back: I phoned the boss the day before yesterday, but it went straight into voicemail.

cards.front: Él me dio un telefonazo ayer para ver cómo estaba, pero había muchas interferencias.
cards.back: He gave me a ring yesterday to check up on me, but there was a lot of interference.

cards.back: I gave him a ring at lunchtime, but there was a lot of interference.

cards.front: Le di un telefonazo a ella, pero saltó el contestador y luego se cortó la línea.
cards.back: I gave her a ring, but it went straight into voicemail and then I got cut off.

cards.front: Colega, llamé al timbre de tu casa de camino a la oficina, pero creo que ya te habías ido.
cards.back: Mate, I gave you a buzz on the way to the office but I think you had already left.

cards.back: She gave me a buzz on my birthday, but there was a lot of interference, so we didn't chat much.

cards.front: Él me dio un telefonazo esta mañana, pero se nos cortó la llamada.
cards.back: He gave me a buzz this morning, but we got cut off.

cards.front: Estoy fuera por trabajo este fin de semana, pero tendré acceso a mi correo, así que avísame si necesitas algo.
cards.back: I'm away on business this weekend but I'll have access to my email; so give me a shout if you need anything.

cards.front: Estoy trabajando en mi oficina de arriba, pero ven a verme si necesitas ayuda.
cards.back: I'm working in my office upstairs, but give me a shout if you need some help.

cards.front: Te daré un toque después del trabajo, ¡pero asegúrate de tener el móvil encendido!
cards.back: I'll give you a shout after work, but make sure you have your phone switched on!
